add.k: A Sokovian boy, Zrinka's little brother
st: Costel is caught in a riot against the Iron Legion in Sokovia, then trapped in the rising city until Clint and Pietro save him.

files.notes: Zrinka shouts 'Costel!' in the opening Novi Grad scene and on the lifeboat ('Costel! We were in the market'); transcript avengers-age-of-ultron. No group named, so Independent. The football and church scenes with the Maximoffs are deleted scenes and are left out.

add.k: A Sokovian woman, Costel's older sister
st: Zrinka pulls Costel from a riot in Sokovia, and later her cries on a lifeboat send Clint back into the battle to save him.

files.notes: Costel calls 'Zrinka!' at their reunion on the lifeboat near the end; transcript avengers-age-of-ultron. No group named, so Independent. Pietro's gifts (football, dress) are a deleted scene and are left out.

k: The voice of Shuri's lab in Wakanda
st: Shuri's lab AI warns Everett Ross that the lab is under attack while he flies a remote jet against Killmonger's cargo planes.
Griot fails to save T'Challa, then helps Shuri escape with Riri, prints a new Heart-Shaped Herb and traps Namor in a Talon Fighter.

files.notes: The name is never said in Black Panther: subtitles only give an AUTOMATED VOICE ('The lab is under attack', 'Glass integrity is at 50%'); the wiki and the home video credits tie it to Griot. Named often in Wakanda Forever ('GRIOT, give me the controls', 'Hey, Mr. GRIOT'). So the name is staged. Group follows the app's Shuri file (Wakanda), like J.A.R.V.I.S. under Stark Industries. Ironheart only mentions Griot, so no step.

add.k: A U.S. senator who backs the super soldier project
st: Senator Brandt watches Steve's transformation, then makes him Captain America, the star of a tour selling war bonds.

files.notes: Phillips: 'Senator Brandt, glad you could make it'; Peggy: 'Is that Senator Brandt I hear?'. Group: the app files senators (Senator Stern) under 'U.S. Congress'; on screen only 'Senator' and his 'committees' and 'pull up on the Hill'. Phillips's report of Steve missing is a letter read in voice-over, so it is not counted as Brandt on screen.

add.k: A Greek hero who leads the Myrmidons at Troy
st: Achilles leads the Myrmidons into Troy inside Odysseus's horse, then dies fighting his friend Memnon over a strange artifact.

files.notes: Named throughout 'Legends and Lies' (EoW ep 2). He appears again in ep 4 only as a silent figure in an illusion, so the last event is ep 2. Filed A: he is B'Kai's ally and friend for nine years and only turns on him after Memnon betrays him in the final fight; T is defensible since that fight is the climax. 'Myrmidons' is said on screen and is the app's group.

st: Gef joins Taserface's mutiny against Yondu and asks to smash Groot with a rock, then dies by Yondu's arrow.

files.notes: Named: 'GEF: We can't even buy a pair of boots with 25 units' and Taserface's 'No, Gef.' (transcript guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2). cl and op copy the app's Taserface file.

st: Bletelsnort falls for Drax under Mantis's spell and opens the gate, then fires on Quill and Gamora in the security booth.

files.notes: He says 'My name is Bletelsnort. Welcome to OrgoCorp headquarters' (transcript guardians-of-the-galaxy-volume-3). The shooting at the security booth is from the wiki; an Orgosentry knocks him down and his fate is not shown, so Active.

st: Jack serves Vanko lunch in Monaco, brings him a bird that is not his, and is at the Expo when Hammer is arrested.

files.notes: Hammer says 'What [do] we have today, Jack?' at the lunch and 'Jack' when telling him to try on the drone head (transcript iron-man-2, a poor machine translation but the name is clear). Presence at the Expo arrest is from the wiki. Filed T as a Hammer Industries hand who serves Vanko; he never fights a hero, so opp is only nominal.

add.k: One of Killian's guards in Miami
st: Guarding a captive Tony, Ponytail Express answers '832 miles', smashes his borrowed watch, and is beaten when Tony's armor arrives.

files.notes: Tony: 'Hey, uh, Ponytail Express. What's the mileage count between Tennessee and Miami?' (transcript iron-man-3). A nickname, but the only name the story uses. Group follows the app, which files Killian's people (Savin, Brandt, even Trevor) under A.I.M.; he is never called A.I.M. himself, so Independent is the fallback.

add.k: A sword-swinging swashbuckler at Blonsky's retreat
st: El Águila's sword fight with Man-Bull wrecks Jen's car, stranding her at Blonsky's retreat, where she joins his group session.

files.notes: He says 'And I am El Águila' and Blonsky calls him 'Alejandro' (transcript she-hulk-attorney-at-law-2022 s01e07). Only on screen in ep 7. Group uses the app's 'Abomaste', as for Man-Bull, Porcupine and Saracen; ep 7 only calls it 'this group' and 'the gang'. A Ms. Marvel set photo is not counted as an appearance.

add.k: An Army general who lends Ross a strike team
st: Joe gathers a strike team for Ross to capture Banner in Brazil and brings in the Royal Marine Emil Blonsky.

files.notes: Only 'Joe' is said ('I know you cashed in some chips for this, Joe'); 'Greller' and 'General' are never said in the theatrical cut (the surname is in a deleted scene and the credits), so n is 'Joe'. He wears a general's uniform. Group U.S. Army: Ross speaks of 'the Army' and Greller is in Army uniform. Filed T alongside Ross (Global) for helping hunt Banner; cl City is a judgment call.

add.k: A getaway driver in Billy Russo's crew
st: Geno rehearses the ReadyQuick robbery with Billy's crew, then tries to run Frank down in his getaway car and is shot dead.

files.notes: Billy: 'Geno, you're our customer at the counter' and 'Geno, you're now flying solo as backup' (transcript marvels-the-punisher-2017 s02e07). Group is the app's 'Jigsaw's Crew'. The wiki calls him an Army veteran, but that is not said of him on screen, so no U.S. Army stage. The car run and his death are from the wiki.

add.k: A gunman in Billy Russo's crew
st: Mike zip-ties the ReadyQuick staff and bags the cash for Billy, then is shot dead by Frank while shielding him.

files.notes: Billy: 'Mike, you spell in with me', 'One here, Mike' and 'Mike, you're off the bench' (transcript marvels-the-punisher-2017 s02e07). Group is the app's 'Jigsaw's Crew'. Army service is from the wiki only, so no U.S. Army stage.

st: Ma Gnucci recalls her son Carlo telling her it is okay and that he loves her as the Punisher kills him at 6:47.

files.notes: Ma: 'And then there was my prince. My beautiful Carlo' and '"I love you, Ma," he said to me'; the surname is hers ('it was the Gnuccis who did it'). He is on screen only in her recollection of his killing. Group is the app's 'The Gnucci Crime Family' (Ma's file); 'all worked for us' is as close as the screen comes to naming it. Filed T as a member of the crime family the Punisher wiped out.

add.k: The king of a world under attack by Habooska
st: King Yakan asks Thor to win back his sacred temple from Habooska, is dismayed when Thor wrecks it, and gives Thor two giant goats.

files.notes: Thor: 'King Yakan. You have finally joined our fight' and 'King Yakan, thank you so much' (transcript thor-love-and-thunder). His world (Indigarr on the wiki) is never named on screen, so Independent.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Zrinka pulls her little brother Costel back from the crowd when the Iron Legion comes to their city. In the battle against Ultron they are separated, and they reunite on a lifeboat after Clint carries him out.
stages.whoA: His older sister
stages.whoB: Her little brother

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hearing Zrinka cry for Costel, Clint goes back into the falling city and pulls the boy from a ruined building. He shields Costel from Ultron's gunfire, and Pietro dies saving them both.
stages.whoA: The Avenger who goes back to save him
stages.whoB: A trapped boy he goes back to save

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: As Ultron strafes Clint and the trapped Costel from a Quinjet, Pietro runs between them and the bullets. He dies shielding the two of them.
stages.whoA: The speedster who dies shielding him
stages.whoB: The boy he dies shielding with Clint

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hurt and safe on a lifeboat, Zrinka screams for her missing brother Costel. Clint hears her and goes back into the city to bring the boy out.
stages.whoA: The Avenger who saves her brother
stages.whoB: A woman whose brother he goes back for

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri's lab AI runs her systems while she guides Everett Ross through a remote jet fight. It warns them when the lab comes under attack.
stages.whoA: His creator, who runs her lab
stages.whoB: Her lab's AI

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot runs Shuri's failed attempt to synthesize the herb that could save T'Challa and tells her he is with the ancestors. Later it prints a new Heart-Shaped Herb at her command and helps her trap Namor.
stages.whoA: Its creator, who gives it every order
stages.whoB: Her AI, which carries out her orders

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: While Ross flies a remote Wakandan jet from Shuri's lab, its AI tracks the fight and warns him that the lab is under attack and its glass is failing.
stages.whoA: The agent it guides through a jet fight
stages.whoB: The voice of Shuri's lab

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ramonda distrusts Griot and warns Shuri that AI will kill them all. After Shuri is taken, she calls on Griot to track her beads and learns her captors spoke Yucatec Mayan.
stages.whoA: The queen who distrusts it, then relies on it
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, which she distrusts

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot drives Riri's car and tracks her flight as she escapes the FBI with Shuri. In the final battle she calls on Mr. Griot for backup, and it scoops Namor into a Talon Fighter.
stages.whoA: The young inventor it backs up in battle
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, her backup in battle

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot turns a Royal Talon Fighter into a chamber to dry Namor out and traps him inside. When his spear wrecks the ship, Griot flies it to the desert for Shuri's fight.
stages.whoA: The enemy it traps in a burning ship
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, which traps him

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Brandt watches Steve come out of the experiment a super soldier. He then sends Steve on a tour as Captain America to sell war bonds, saying bonds buy bullets.
stages.whoA: The senator who puts him on stage
stages.whoB: The super soldier he turns into a bond act

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Phillips has groveled to Brandt's committees for funding and greets him in Brooklyn for the experiment. After Erskine's murder, Brandt takes Steve away from Phillips for the bond tour.
stages.whoA: The colonel who courts him for funding
stages.whoB: The senator who funds his project

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Achilles calls Memnon brother after nine years at war together and gives him his mother's charm. In Troy, Memnon leaves him for dead to take an artifact, and Achilles dies fighting him for it.
stages.whoA: Memnon, his brother in arms, who kills him
stages.whoB: The Greek hero he befriends, then kills

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gef complains that Yondu's quarter mill is not enough and joins the mutiny against him. When Yondu escapes, his arrow kills Gef.
stages.whoA: His old captain, who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager who mutinies against him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gef sides with Taserface in the mutiny and cheers him as the new captain. Taserface turns down Gef's request to smash Groot with a rock.
stages.whoA: The mutineer he follows as captain
stages.whoB: A loyal follower in his mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After the mutiny, Gef asks if he can smash the captured Baby Groot with a rock. Taserface says no, and the crew bullies Groot instead.
stages.whoA: The little tree he wants to smash
stages.whoB: A Ravager who wants to smash him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mantis makes the OrgoCorp guard fall for Drax, and Bletelsnort flirts with him and opens the gate. He promises to be waiting when Drax comes back out.
stages.whoA: The man he is made to adore
stages.whoB: The guard who falls for him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mantis touches Bletelsnort as he asks for identification and makes him fall in love with Drax. He lets the two of them into OrgoCorp headquarters.
stages.whoA: The empath who bends his heart
stages.whoB: The guard she charms to get inside

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Bletelsnort finds Quill and Gamora in the Orgoscope's security booth and opens fire. Quill turns the Orgosentries on each other, and one knocks the guard down.
stages.whoA: An intruder he shoots at
stages.whoB: A guard who fires on him

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Jack waits on Hammer at lunch with Vanko in Monaco and runs his errands. Hammer has him fetch a bird for Vanko and try on a drone head.
stages.whoA: His boss
stages.whoB: His assistant

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Jack serves Vanko lunch in Monaco and later brings him a bird, which Vanko says is not his. He holds a drone head as Vanko explains why drones beat suits.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he waits on for Hammer
stages.whoB: Hammer's assistant who waits on him

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Guarding the tied up Tony, the henchman answers his mileage question, then smashes a watch that belongs to Harley's sister. Tony's armor arrives piece by piece and Tony beats him.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who vows to kill him first
stages.whoB: A guard he nicknames Ponytail Express

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: El Águila and Man-Bull fight with sword and horns and smash Jen's car. They needle each other through the group session, and Blonsky makes one of them change seats.
stages.whoA: His sparring partner and constant foe
stages.whoB: The swashbuckler he keeps fighting

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Blonsky runs the retreat where El Águila works through his identity issues. He scolds Alejandro for using bio-electricity in group.
stages.whoA: The leader of his retreat
stages.whoB: A member of his retreat

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: El Águila's fight wrecks Jen's car and strands her at the retreat. He swears Josh is now the group's enemy, and he says goodbye when her tow truck comes.
stages.whoA: The lawyer whose car he wrecked
stages.whoB: A swashbuckler at Blonsky's retreat

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Joe gathers a strike team for Ross at short notice to capture Banner in Brazil. Ross thanks him for cashing in some chips.
stages.whoA: The general he does favors for
stages.whoB: The general who lends him a team

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Joe brings in Blonsky as his one ace, born in Russia and on loan from the Royal Marines. He places him on Ross's team.
stages.whoA: The ace soldier he brings in
stages.whoB: The general who brings him in

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy drills his crew for the ReadyQuick robbery and casts Geno as a customer at the counter. On the day he makes Geno the getaway backup.
stages.whoA: The crew leader he drives for
stages.whoB: His backup driver

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: After the ReadyQuick robbery, Frank attacks Billy's crew in the street. Geno tries to run him down with the car, and Frank shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A getaway driver he kills

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake and Geno rehearse the robbery together and trade insults about who will mess it up. Geno grumbles at being left as backup.
stages.whoA: A crewmate he bickers with
stages.whoB: A crewmate he bickers with

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Geno and Mike train together for the ReadyQuick job in Billy's crew. On the day Mike goes in, Geno waits in the car, and Frank kills them both.
stages.whoA: A fellow gunman in Billy's crew
stages.whoB: The crew's backup driver

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy calls Mike off the bench for the ReadyQuick robbery, and Mike ties up the staff and bags the cash. When Frank attacks, Mike dies shielding Billy.
stages.whoA: The crew leader he dies shielding
stages.whoB: A gunman who dies shielding him

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank ambushes Billy's crew outside the ReadyQuick. Mike tries to get Billy away, and Frank shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A gunman he kills

stages.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
stages.text: Ma Gnucci calls Carlo her beautiful prince and insists he never touched those kids. She remembers him telling her it was okay as he died, and she builds her revenge around 6:47.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her favorite son

stages.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
stages.text: The Punisher stops Carlo's car, drags him out and kills him at 6:47 as his mother watches. Ma Gnucci sets her bounty on Frank for that same time.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, who kills him
stages.whoB: One of the Gnucci sons he kills

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Yakan welcomes Thor to the fight for his sacred temple, then watches him smash it to pieces finishing off Habooska. He thanks the heroes with two giant goats, which Thor must take.
stages.whoA: The hero who saves and wrecks his temple
stages.whoB: The king who gives him the goats

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Habooska's hordes seize the sacred temple of Yakan's people after their gods are murdered. Thor defeats Habooska inside the temple.
stages.whoA: The warlord who took his temple
stages.whoB: The king whose temple he takes
